name: named-definition
body: A named, reusable definition declared in `library.yaml`: a `group` (a named accept-list used in a section declaration's `accepted:` as `@<name>`), a `field_set` (a named field group used in a template's `fields:` as `- include: <name>`) or a `type` (a named field type used as `type: <name>`, e.g. a `colour` enum). A definition resolves when the library loads; an unknown reference is a templates error with a closest-match suggestion. Additive to library.yaml format 1.
